description: Source of truth for project delivery tasks. Generated delivery reports and dashboards must never become task truth.

tasks.title: Create project delivery system foundation
tasks.problem: Studio OS has strong governance but lacks a practical delivery layer that tells Bas what to build next.
tasks.expectedOutcome: A deterministic task intake, prioritization, delivery board, prompt generator, and cockpit for four supported projects.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard identifies the highest-priority next task per supported project.
Every task has generated acceptance criteria, Codex prompt, review checklist, and release checklist.
Boundary flags prove no execution, provider, GitHub, deployment, or agent capability exists.

tasks.title: Build Etsy listing workflow foundation
tasks.problem: NumberNinjaDesigns product and listing work can fragment across keywords, mockups, copy, SEO, and publish checks.
tasks.expectedOutcome: A repeatable Etsy listing workflow with keyword inputs, title formula, description structure, mockup checklist, SEO tags, and release checklist.
acceptanceCriteria: Workflow covers keyword research, listing title, description, tags, images, price notes, and publish checks.
Output uses the NumberNinjaDesigns tactical premium brand tone.
Workflow can be reused for at least ten product ideas without redesign.

tasks.title: Create product idea backlog for data and spreadsheet humor shirts
tasks.problem: The brand needs a structured backlog of product concepts before design and listing work can scale.
tasks.expectedOutcome: A prioritized product idea backlog with target persona, joke angle, SEO angle, and listing readiness notes.
acceptanceCriteria: Backlog contains at least 25 product ideas.
Each idea has audience, joke, keyword angle, and confidence score.
Top five ideas are ready for listing workflow execution.

tasks.title: Define content production pipeline
tasks.problem: TOK Hub can expand into automation before the repeatable content workflow is defined.
tasks.expectedOutcome: A documented idea-to-publish content pipeline with intake, script, asset, review, publish, and metrics states.
acceptanceCriteria: Pipeline defines each state from idea to metrics review.
Pipeline identifies manual steps that should not be automated yet.
Pipeline can support at least three content channels later.

tasks.title: Define first grocery comparison workflow
tasks.problem: The project needs a concrete first comparison workflow before data source or UI implementation choices make sense.
tasks.expectedOutcome: A first workflow definition for comparing grocery prices with source assumptions, user flow, risk notes, and MVP output.
blockers: Data source strategy is not selected.
acceptanceCriteria: Workflow identifies input product, store/source, comparison result, and user decision point.
Data source risks are explicitly listed.
MVP can be implemented without committing to full automation.

tasks.title: Link project cockpit output to daily operating routine
tasks.problem: Generated delivery views only create value if Bas uses them as a daily project selection routine.
tasks.expectedOutcome: A short operating routine for reviewing next tasks, blockers, Codex prompts, and release readiness.
acceptanceCriteria: Routine takes less than ten minutes.
Routine ends with one selected task and one Codex prompt.
